default.notes: Not eligible for the eVisa or visa on arrival — a visit visa must be arranged in advance through a sponsor in Kuwait or a Kuwaiti embassy.

groups.notes: GCC citizens may enter Kuwait freely under Gulf Cooperation Council arrangements — a national ID card is accepted and no visa is needed.
Eligible for the Kuwait tourist eVisa (KWD 3) or a visa on arrival at the airport for stays of up to three months — confirm current eligibility on the official portal before travel.

IL.notes: Kuwait does not admit Israeli passport holders, and travellers of any nationality whose passports show Israeli stamps or visas are refused entry.

KW.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Kuwaiti citizens.
